whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Zumba Studio,

I noticed your studio has exceptional 4.9★ reviews in Rajabazar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries and batch schedules.

Maine aapke studio ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://zumba-studio-demo.local

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Zumba Studio team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Zumba Studio near Pillar No 76, Rajabazar) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? 

*(If checked)*: Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? 
*(If not checked)*: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai. 
Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services aur batch timings setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein!
